name: Tower stair
_about: A STAIR UP A SQUARE TOWER: a round turret in the tower -- in its (+x, +z) inner corner unless `tx`, `tz` put it elsewhere -- its door toward the tower's middle, a spiral in it from the ground to the floor at the top, and that floor -- the whole of the tower's inside but the turret's own head, the hatch the stair arrives through, in up to four pieces round it. Place it at the tower's middle; `W` is the tower's inside width. Notre-Dame's, Cologne's and the Stephansdom's towers are climbed by it.

params._W: the tower's inside, a square W across; H the floor the stair arrives at
params._c: the turret's middle, in the tower's (+x, +z) inner corner, touching both walls; e: its near side
params._doorBay: the bay of n its door is in: by default the one facing the tower's middle
params._tx: the turret's middle (default c, c: the +x, +z inner corner); anywhere else in the tower -- against the middle of a wall, say -- and the floor goes round it
params._n: the turret's bays: few enough that each is wider than its door (a metre)
params._a: the turret's faces from its middle (a polygon of n): the floor reaches them
params._hand: which way the spiral winds: "left" mirrors it (a pair of towers, one each way, arrive on the same side)

turret._about: the stair's round turret, standing in the tower's corner from the floor to the top

stair._about: the spiral, up to the top floor: its first step at the door

floor west._about: the floor at the top, round the turret's head -- the hatch the stair arrives through: the part on its -x side...

floor south._about: ...and in line with it, before and behind (each left out where there is no room for it)
